githubCapability.symptom: Every git command in a run prints 'Paperclip: GitHub capability_missing; continuing without managed credentials.' and no GitHub-backed write can complete.
githubCapability.rootCause: The Paperclip server process has no signing secret. server/src/runtime-tools-token.ts createRuntimeToolsToken() returns null when neither PAPERCLIP_AGENT_JWT_SECRET nor BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is set, so prepareHeartbeatGitHubLaunchers() mints an empty broker token and packages/adapter-utils/src/github-launcher.ts reports capability_missing.
evidence: server process env (pid 78457) contains HOST/PORT/PAPERCLIP_INSTANCE_ID only - no PAPERCLIP_AGENT_JWT_SECRET, no BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
run env: PAPERCLIP_GITHUB_BROKER_URL set, PAPERCLIP_GITHUB_BROKER_TOKEN empty (len 0)

the instance already has an active managed GitHub tool connection (5a75fd48-c3a5-4f9f-b866-a6513424dfec, transport mcp_remote, healthStatus ok, 'GitHub account, installation, and repository access are available', company-scoped install, grant aa10fb5e for user local-board, appSlug paperclip-for-github, installationId 173560379, repositories include the private calligentai/bussiness-empire)

consequence: no external GitHub token is required - the platform already holds a GitHub App identity. The missing piece was the local signing secret, so the board ask 'inject a GitHub token' was based on the wrong cause.
